The season started on 20 August 2019 and concluded on 20 September 2020.{{cite web |title=مواعيد بداية مباريات #الدوري_السعودي_للمحترفين و #دوري_الأمير_محمد_بن_سلمان للدرجة الأولى |url=https://twitter.com/SPL/status/1138513238633668609}} Fixtures for the 2019–20 season were announced on 14 July 2019.{{cite web |title=جدول مباریات دوري الأمیر محمد بن سلمان لأندیة الدرجة الأولى للمحترفین |url=https://spl.com.sa/Mbs1.pdf}} [[Al-Batin FC|Al-Batin]] won the title, with [[Al-Qadsiah FC|Al-Qadsiah]] and [[Al-Ain FC (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Ain]] following in second and third respectively. On 7 March 2020, the [[General Sports Authority|Ministry of Sports]] announced that all matches would be played behind closed doors until further notice.{{cite web |title=وزارة الرياضة تُقرر تعليق الحضور الجماهيري في جميع المنافسات الرياضية في كافة الألعاب اعتباراً من يوم غدٍ السبت |url=https://www.spa.gov.sa/viewfullstory.php?lang=ar&newsid=2043837 |language=arabic}} On 14 March 2020, the Ministry suspended all sports competitions indefinitely due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.spa.gov.sa/viewstory.php?lang=ru&newsid=2047561|title=عام / وزارة الرياضة : تعليق النشاط الرياضي بالمملكة وإغلاق الصالات والمراكز الرياضية الخاصة|website=www.spa.gov.sa}} On 11 June 2020, the Ministry of Sports announced the resumption of sports activities with training starting on 21 June and games starting after 4 August 2020 and played behind closed doors.{{cite web| url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-saudi-sports/saudi-arabia-will-resume-sports-activities-without-fans-starting-from-june-21-idUSKBN23I3EQ| title=Saudi Arabia will resume sports activities, without fans starting from June 21| work=Reuters| date=11 June 2020}} On 1 July 2020, the schedule for the remaining matches was released. It was announced that the league would resume on 4 August 2020 and end on 20 September 2020.{{cite web |title=لجنة المسابقات برابطة #الدوري_السعودي_للمحترفين تعلن جدولة مواعيد الجولات المتبقية من مسابقة #دوري_الامير_محمد_بن_سلمان للدرجة الأولى للمحترفين|url=https://twitter.com/M_S_League/status/1278366614799429639}} ==Overview== ===Rule changes=== On 9 June 2019, the SAFF announced that the numbers of foreign players were decreased from 7 players to 4 players.{{cite web |title=الاتحاد السعودي لكرة القدم يعتمد عدد اللاعبين المحترفين الأجانب والمواليد للموسم الرياضي 2019-2020 |url=https://twitter.com/saudiFF/status/1137806956402499584}} ==Teams== A total of 20 teams are contesting the league, including 13 sides from the [[2018–19 Prince Mohammad bin Salman League|2018–19 season]], 4 promoted teams from the [[2018–19 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]] and the three relegated sides from the [[2018–19 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]. The first team to be relegated to the MS League was [[Ohod Club|Ohod]], ending a 2-year stay in the Pro League following a 3–1 home defeat to [[Al-Fayha FC|Al-Fayha]] on 12 April 2019.{{cite web |title=الفيحاء يعلن هبوط احد رسمياً والتعاون يتغلب على القادسية |url=https://freeswcc.com/ar/archives/214812 |access-date=2019-07-17 |archive-date=2020-01-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200102150325/https://freeswcc.com/ar/archives/214812 |url-status=usurped }} The second team to be relegated was [[Al-Batin F.C.|Al-Batin]], ending a 3-year stay in the Pro League following a 1–0 home defeat to an already relegated Ohod side on 11 May 2019.{{cite web |title=الباطن يهبط إلى دوري الدرجة الأولى السعودي |url=https://www.goal.com/ar-sa/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%86-%D9%8A%D9%87%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%AC%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A/1uhblub1zur2n1ufiy89jtkuck}} The third and final team to be relegated was [[Al-Qadsiah FC|Al-Qadsiah]], who were relegated on the final matchday following a 2–2 home draw with [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]]. Al-Qadsiah were relegated after 4 consecutive seasons in the Pro League.{{cite web |title=هبوط القادسية.. والحزم في انتظار الملحق.. والأهلي يمطر الاتفاق |date=16 May 2019 |url=https://www.slaati.com/2019/05/17/p1401374.html}} The first club to be promoted was [[Al-Bukayriyah FC|Al-Bukayriyah]] who were promoted following a 1–1 away draw against [[Al-Jandal Club|Al-Jandal]] on 16 March 2019.{{cite web |title=البكيرية يصعد لدوري الأمير محمد بن سلمان لأول مرة في تاريخه |url=https://www.alriyadh.com/1743916}} The second club to be promoted was [[Hetten FC|Hetten]] following a 2–0 home win against [[Afif F.C.|Afif]] on 29 March 2019.{{cite web |title=حطين يتأهل رسميًّا لدوري الأمير محمد بن سلمان لأندية الدرجة الأولى |url=https://www.almowaten.net/2019/03/%D8%AD%D8%B7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%8A%D8%AA%D8%A3%D9%87%D9%84-%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%91%D9%8B%D8%A7-%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%AF-%D8%A8/}} The third club to be promoted was [[Al-Thoqbah Club|Al-Thoqbah]] who were promoted following a 3–1 home win against Arar on 29 March 2019.{{cite web |title=الثقبة يصعد لدوري الأولى بعد 46 عاماً |date=April 2019 |url=https://shahdnow.com/88076/}} The fourth and final club to be promoted was [[Al-Taqadom FC|Al-Taqadom]] who were promoted on the final matchday following a 3–0 home win against [[Al-Muzahimiyyah Club|Al-Muzahimiyyah]].{{cite web |title=التقدم آخر المتأهلين لدوري الأمير محمد بن سلمان للدرجة الأولى |date=7 April 2019 |url=https://ajel.sa/6Lt9MT/}} [[Hetten FC|Hetten]] were promoted as the winners of the [[2018–19 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]] and [[Al-Bukayriyah FC|Al-Bukayriyah]] were promoted as the runners-up.{{cite web |title=حطين بطلًا لدوري الدرجة الثانية |date=13 April 2019 |url=https://ajel.sa/HnwCDG/ |accessdate=14 April 2019}} [[Al-Thoqbah Club|Al-Thoqbah]] defeated [[Al-Taqadom FC|Al-Taqadom]] in the third-place playoffs. Al-Bukayriyah, Al-Taqadom, and Al-Thoqbah will play in the [[Prince Mohammad bin Salman League]] for the first time in their history. Hetten will play in their 8th overall season in the MS League. This will be their first season in the MS League following their relegation in the [[2014–15 Saudi First Division|2014–15 season]]. ==Team changes== The following teams have changed division since the 2019–20 season. {{column |1= ===To MS League=== '''Promoted from [[2018–19 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Hetten FC|Hetten]] * [[Al-Bukayriyah FC|Al-Bukayriyah]] * [[Al-Thoqbah Club|Al-Thoqbah]] * [[Al-Taqadom FC|Al-Taqadom]] '''Relegated from [[2018–19 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Al-Qadsiah FC|Al-Qadsiah]] * [[Al-Batin F.C.|Al-Batin]] * [[Ohod Club|Ohod]] |2= ===From MS League=== '''Promoted to [[2019–20 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Abha Club|Abha]] * [[Damac F.C.|Damac]] * [[Al-Adalah F.C.|Al-Adalah]] '''Relegated to [[2019–20 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Al-Qaisumah FC|Al-Qaisumah]] * [[Hajer Club|Hajer]] * [[Al-Washm Club|Al-Washm]] * [[Al-Orobah F.C.|Al-Orobah]] }} ==Stadia and locations==
